extDescription.message: A local-first tab and session manager.

popup_no_active.message: No active session in this window yet.

ob_welcome_title.message: Your windows, kept the way you left them.

ob_welcome_body.message: Tabbary saves each browser window as a session the moment it changes — tabs, groups and all. Close a window by accident, or crash, and it is still there.

ob_fact_no_account_body.message: Nothing to sign up for, no email, no profile.

ob_fact_stored_body.message: Everything lives in this Chrome profile.

ob_fact_mit_body.message: The source is open, so you can audit or fork it.

ob_capture_body.message: There is no save button to forget. Every tab, group, pin and window move is written shortly after it happens, and each session keeps a short revision history.

ob_restore_legend.message: When Chrome starts, restore the windows tabbary was tracking?

ob_restore_yes_hint.message: Matched back to their sessions by URL, so history survives.

ob_restore_ask_hint.message: Show a prompt with the matches and let me choose.

ob_restore_no_hint.message: Leave everything closed; I will restore manually.

ob_surfaces_title.message: Where you need it, not where we say.

ob_surfaces_body.message: The same library is available as a popup, a side panel, a dedicated window, and a full tab. They share state, so switching is cheap.

ob_surface_popup_body.message: Click the toolbar icon. Alt+A opens the side panel.

ob_surface_tab_body.message: Alt+S. The three-pane manager with drag-and-drop.

ob_surface_window_body.message: A compact two-pane view for a second screen.

ob_surface_side_body.message: Stays open beside the page you are reading.

ob_privacy_title.message: Nothing leaves unless you say so.

ob_privacy_body.message: The extension asks for no host permissions at install. History and bookmark access are optional and requested only when you use those features.

ob_sync_connected.message: Connected to $1. Blobs are encrypted here before upload.

ob_sync_off.message: Off by default. If you turn it on, you point it at a server you run; it stores ciphertext only.

ob_export_body.message: Settings → Import & export writes plain JSON or a passphrase-encrypted file. No lock-in.

ob_done_body.message: Open a window and tabbary starts capturing. Press ? in the manager for keyboard shortcuts.

ob_revisit.message: You can revisit these settings any time; nothing here is permanent.

opt_intro.message: Defaults favour privacy. Everything is stored in this browser profile, and the source is open for anyone to audit.

opt_restore_hint.message: Whether tabbary reopens the windows it was tracking when Chrome starts.

opt_session_mode_body.message: Tabbary currently tracks one session per browser window. A combined “single window” mode is not implemented, so the option is not shown rather than pretending to work.

opt_autosave_hint.message: Persist tabs as they change. Turning this off freezes session state until you save manually.

opt_surface_hint.message: Where the toolbar button opens tabbary.

opt_search_hint.message: What the search box matches. Session names, tab titles and URLs, or both.

opt_density_hint.message: Compact rows fit more sessions in the rail.

opt_sessions_desc.message: What counts as a session, and when it closes.

opt_open_suspended_hint.message: Restore tabs without loading them until they are clicked.

opt_revisions_hint.message: Older revisions are pruned first. Higher values use more disk.

opt_tabs_desc.message: Behaviour when restoring and opening tabs.

opt_tabs_suspended_hint.message: Uses Chrome's native discard rather than rewriting the URL.

opt_discard_note_after.message: instead of sending tabs through a third-party suspense service, so the address bar always shows the real URL.

opt_data_desc.message: Move your sessions in and out. Everything is processed on this device.

opt_sync_desc.message: Optional, self-hosted, and encrypted on this device before anything is uploaded.

opt_history_desc.message: What tabbary keeps on this device.

opt_local_body.message: Sessions, groups, tags, and revisions live in IndexedDB inside this browser profile. Nothing is uploaded, and removing the extension removes the data.

opt_reset_confirm.message: Reset all settings to their defaults?

opt_account_body.message: tabbary has no sign-in, no user profile, and no server holding your data. If you later run the optional sync server, it stores ciphertext only and you hold the key.

sync_optional_body_after.message: run. Sessions are encrypted on this device before upload, so the server holds ciphertext it cannot read. There is no account and no vendor in the middle.

sync_setup_body.message: First device. Creates the encryption key and recovery phrase.

sync_join_body.message: Second device. Uses the passphrase to unlock the existing key.

sync_server_hint.message: Where your sync server is running. http://localhost:8787 for a local one.

sync_secret_hint.message: The TABBARY_PAIRING_SECRET your server was started with. Sent once, stored by the server only as a hash.

sync_pass_create_hint.message: At least 10 characters. It unlocks the data key and never leaves this device.

sync_pass_existing_hint.message: The passphrase set on your first device.

sync_device_hint.message: Shown in the server's device list. Optional.

sync_create_note.message: You will be shown a 24-word recovery phrase. It is the only way back in if you forget the passphrase — there is nobody who can reset it.

sync_recovery_body.message: These 24 words unlock your synced data if you forget the passphrase. They are shown once and are not stored anywhere.

sync_copied.message: Recovery phrase copied to the clipboard.

sync_recovery_file_footer.message: Keep this offline. Anyone with it can read your synced sessions.

sync_saved_checkbox.message: I have saved my recovery phrase somewhere offline.

sync_forget_note.message: Forgetting removes the server URL, its host permission, and this device's keys. Data already on the server is untouched; delete the server's database to remove it.

sync_paused_body.message: Sync is paused. Enter your passphrase to resume on this device.

sync_unlock_body.message: Enter your 24-word recovery phrase to unlock syncing on this device.

sync_run_own_note.message: The server keeps ciphertext, device token hashes, and a monotonic revision counter. Put it behind TLS (Caddy, nginx, or a tunnel) before using it from another machine.

bm_empty_browser_body.message: Import Chrome’s bookmark tree to browse it here and open folders as sessions.

bm_empty_session_body.message: Bookmarks here live with their session. Add one, or save a session’s tabs.

bm_empty_tag_body.message: Tag bookmarks are shared by every session carrying that tag.

bm_open_folder.message: Open this folder as a session

rev_select.message: Select a revision to preview it.

rev_live_note.message: The live window will be updated to match.

ft_no_selection_body.message: Pick a session on the left to see its groups, tabs, and revision history.

dw_select.message: Select a session to see its tabs.

tg_select_body.message: See every session carrying it, then rename or remove it in bulk.

dp_export_body.message: Plain JSON is human-readable and has no lock-in. Encryption is optional.

sd_suspend_title.message: Discard idle tabs in this window (native Chrome discard)
